reviews.review: Take a walk in power armor. Kill orks. Lots of orks. Single player is the best part of this game if you ask me.

fun. 3rd person view of this game series.

All the DLCs are for multiplayer though, and since this game is 6 years old and little or no people plays this game anymore(except perhaps a short singleplayer thrill), buy the cheaper, base game will do, instead of the master collection(that includes all the redundant DLCs)

What can I say, there is one very fitting line to describe this game: Its bloody Warhammer 40k at its finest! The singleplayer is a great challange offering slow motion to let you admire the carnage and gore in executing your enemies and also a great ttraining for the exterminatus mode. The multiplayer is also great fun, making you think technically, adapt to the current situation and also be one of the greatest tactical, devestator or assault! I can safely suggest that you should play this gem at least once. Make the Emperor proud Battle Brother! :)

I like how it's a WarHammer Game with a third person view that doesn't change to vibe of the game at all and the combat system is unlike any I've played before but what I like most is the combat system that allows you to personally fight your enemies.

Majority of my playtime was on the Xbox 360, re-purchased while this was on sale as I thought it was a good enough game. 

I'll start with what I didn't like. The campaign. The story seemed pretty bland and the missions were way too easy (even on hard). I got about half way through before I jumped into multiplayer.

What I liked, and where I spent hundreds of hours. The multiplayer has a pretty sweet progression / class system with fully customizable marines / chaos marines. I liked the variety of weapons and perk upgrades. The unlockables are enough to keep you occupied for hours on end.
